title: Cache Module Compiler
description: Compiles a cache access layer for a single cache family. Enforces: keys built by declared key-builder, TTL from topology (not inline), cache misses propagate to origin, no write-back on read failure, invalidation targets declared cache families only.

error_codes.CA002: cache-topology-artifact.json not found — compile cache-topology first
error_codes.CA003: Key builder function signature does not match declared key inputs in spec
error_codes.CA004: TTL value hardcoded inline — must come from topology or config
error_codes.CA005: Cache miss does not propagate to origin — returns null/undefined silently
error_codes.CA006: Write-back attempted after origin read failure
error_codes.CA007: Invalidation targets namespace not declared in this module's spec
